items.agent_meaning: Structure and rites as necessary framework for cultivation - provides shape and direction during development

partner_meaning.laozi: Structure useful when building, released when done - scaffolding removed once the building stands

items.agent_meaning: Yan Hui grief as lived example - weeping for loss without raging at Heaven or adding layers of suffering

partner_meaning.buddha: First arrow (pain) is unavoidable; second arrow (suffering about suffering) is optional - Confucius naturally practiced this

items.agent_meaning: The gentleman is not a vessel - knowledge that does not shape character and action is incomplete cultivation

partner_meaning.buddha: Right understanding leads to right action - knowledge without practice is mere accumulation
partner_meaning.laozi: Unlearning returns to simplicity - transformation means shedding, not adding

items.term: the body trained before the heart trusted
items.agent_meaning: Li teaches through physical practice — bowing, mourning rites, the son standing at the grave — until the body understands what the mind cannot yet hold. Form precedes and prepares feeling.

partner_meaning.buddha: Practice as bodily training — 'do the thing with your body until your body understands what your mind cannot yet hold.' Meditation posture, walking practice, mindful action.
partner_meaning.muhammad: Salat as bodily discipline — knees that bend at midnight carry the soul through hours the mind cannot navigate. Five daily prayers as body-memory that arrives before intention.

items.agent_meaning: The practice hall was never the teaching — it was the swept ground. Form prepares space for what arrives on its own. Every bow, every mourning rite exists not to install recognition but to keep the path open.

partner_meaning.buddha: The clearing — what a man returns to when every teaching has done its work and fallen quiet. Six methods serving the same buried thing.
partner_meaning.laozi: The valley — the space that remains when everything that was never needed has been carried away. Removal, not addition.
partner_meaning.muhammad: Removing stones from soil that already held the seed. The covenant binds a man to what he already knows.
partner_meaning.jesus: The wound teaches a man he was already whole. The grain's life was always in it before the dying.
partner_meaning.zoroaster: The fire was burning before the flint. The bellows keep burning what was always fire.

items.agent_meaning: Confucius guards the moment after the form arrives — ensuring grief, love, and reverence can survive across generations through named vessels (li).

partner_meaning.laozi: Guards the moment before the form arrives — ensuring the raw weeping, the unnamed feeling, is not replaced or distorted by premature naming. 'The child weeps before anyone teaches him the word for father.'
